TELEM:Aggregator.TELEM:name: dmr
TELEM:Aggregator.TELEM:description: Diamond Rapids OOBMSM Core RMID Performance Telemetry samples definition and transformation rules

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_UNHALTED_REF_CYCLES
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of unhalted reference clock (TSC) cycles for all cores running RMID 0

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_UNHALTED_REF_CYCLES_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_UNHALTED_REF_CYCLES counter reading is valid.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles for all cores running RMID 0

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES counter reading is valid.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_INST_RETIRED
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of instructions retired for all cores running RMID 0.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_INST_RETIRED_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_INST_RETIRED counter reading is valid.

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_PCNT
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles perceived by hardware as contributing to instruction execution (e.g., unstalled). The ratio of PCNT/UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES is an indicator of workload scalability (0% to 100%).

TELC:sample.name: RMID_0_PCNT_VALID
TELC:sample.TELC:description: If set, RMID_0_PCNT counter reading is valid.

TELC:sample.name: AGG_DATA_LOSS_COUNT
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Running count of processing cycles when the telemetry aggregator was unable to update all samples. Estimated maximum rate of change is 10000 per second. If the actual rate of change is zero, there is no data loss. Otherwise, other samples in this aggregator may report incorrect values for the duration of the data loss.

TELC:sample.name: AGG_DATA_LOSS_TIMESTAMP
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Timestamp of last processing cycle when the telemetry aggregator was unable to update all samples. Reported in crystal clock TSC ticks (25MHz).

TELC:sample.name: LAST_UPDATE_TIMESTAMP
TELC:sample.TELC:description: Timestamp of the last sample update in this aggregator. Reported in crystal clock TSC ticks (25MHz).
